en.html:
I went to the chamber where Shirou Kuniuji Ashikaga was waiting, understanding almost nothing of why.

On the way I had tried asking the lady who led me. She gave me one curt answer, "Don't know," and after that, nothing.

Whether she truly didn't know, who could say? Pressing her was not possible, so I closed my mouth and walked.

An inner room, at the back. At her signal I stepped in. The lady did not follow. Behind me she shut the sliding door with a bang that had opinions.

en.html:
True, if ceremony were being respected, a court noble speaking with a public officer of my kind was impossible from the start.

...Then what had brought this on? The boy might have liked me very much after the other day's business. Even so, surely he had not summoned me into an inner chamber for football talk.

He had dispensed with my greeting. Very good. But his own business was not beginning either. Only a silence searching for words.

Considering our two positions, prompting him from my side was out of the question. Now then. What to do?

en.html:
Kageaki"As a general belief, Your Highness, yes."
邦氏"General belief..."
Kageaki"For men, the equivalent would be: men enjoy watching baseball, men enjoy eating meat. I humbly submit it is that sort of statement."
邦氏"Hm... But there are plenty of men who like neither meat nor baseball."
Kageaki"Precisely, Your Highness."
邦氏"Then a woman need not like flowers either?"
Kageaki"It depends on the person. As the saying goes, dumplings before flowers."
邦氏"Dumplings before flowers..."
Kageaki"Yes."
邦氏"Then dumplings would be better...?"
Kageaki"Yes."
邦氏"Arata! Sach mein—do you seriously think so?! Suddenly handing a woman dumplings—is that proper conduct between a man and a woman?!"
Kageaki"No, Your Highness. That would be a rather avant-garde undertaking."

en.html:
Kageaki"What Your Highness wishes to give Princess Sakurako is not the thing itself."
邦氏"...?"
Kageaki"Through the occasion of a gift, you wish to deliver the care that would comfort her."
邦氏"Y-yes."
Kageaki"Therefore, the thing itself may be anything at all, provided it can carry Your Highness's feeling."
Kageaki"If we knew which article the princess herself desires, that would be different. But only she can know it, and so this one point is what counts. Please choose as your heart tells you."
邦氏"What if she dislikes some useless thing I send...?"
Kageaki"I do not think Your Highness need worry. A common fool like me cannot presume to measure a noble person's character."
Kageaki"But that princess will surely receive Your Highness's kindness together with the gift."
邦氏"...I see..."
邦氏"Yes, you are right! Thank you, Arata. My confusion has cleared."
Kageaki"Yes, Your Highness."
